info.title: Afribox API
info.description: Afribox backend API (SmartParcel). All endpoints accept JSON over POST (unless noted). Authentication is via an `apikey` in the request body: an Application API key, a Business public key, or a Business secret key. The HTTP status is always 200; the outcome is reported in the body via `statuscode` (`00` = success) and `statusmessage`.

tags.name: customer
tags.description: End-user accounts: signup/login/OTP, profile, saved cards, parcels, support.

tags.name: business
tags.description: Business/partner accounts: dashboard, boxes, parcels, wallet, transaction history.

tags.name: kiosk
tags.description: Locker/device operations: setup, ping, parcel drop/collect, appless reserve/verify, snapshots.

tags.name: pay
tags.description: Payments: parcel payment search/success, and the Paystack initialize/verify/status/return/webhook endpoints.

tags.name: admin
tags.description: Administrative operations: businesses list and wallet transactions.

post.description: Creates a Paystack transaction. Authentication accepts **either** a Business secret key (B2B) **or** an Application API key plus an optional `customerid` (B2C). `amount` is in major units (XOF). Use `metadata.parcelreference` to mark a parcel paid, or `metadata.fulfil="wallet"` to credit a business wallet. The response includes `authorizationurl` (hosted checkout) and `accesscode` (for the Paystack popup).

200.description: Result envelope (statuscode/statusmessage). Non-`00` statuscode indicates an error.

post.description: Verifies a payment by `reference`, records it, and fulfils (parcel paid / wallet credit) idempotently. A previously-recorded success is never downgraded. Returns the parcel `collectcode` for parcel payments.

200.description: Result envelope (statuscode/statusmessage). Non-`00` statuscode indicates an error.

PaystackVerifyResponse.description: Verified transaction details, including parcel collectcode when applicable.
